source_refs.note: Topic 7.6.5.2 with the Did You Know (PDF 190-191, printed 187-188). Some ligatures print as stray symbols ('After creating'). The 2020 bill is carried as the book's statement; its status is not verified, flagged.

items: Surveys and forms: collect users' opinions to improve content, for example asking visitors about their experience of a new website.
Direct communication: talk to users about their needs, for example asking classmates for input on a presentation.

blocks.text: In 2020 Pakistan introduced the Personal Data Protection Bill, which would require organizations to get explicit consent before collecting personal data and to store it securely (Did You Know).
